title: AuthorityContract
description: Data of the authority contract: the closed vocabularies, the resolution order, the placeholders and the command and network conventions that the reference model and every enforcement layer share.

schema_version.description: Contract version of the data. Must be 1.

profile_document_version.description: Version of the authority profile document this data describes. Must be 1.

uncovered_policies.description: Policies a category may use for a request no rule covers.

default_uncovered_policy.description: Policy used when a profile does not state one. Deny is the value of version 1.

resolution.description: How a profile is located and selected among the sources.

order.description: Sources in precedence order: the first source that defines the profile governs it.

file_name_template.description: File name of a profile, with the profile name in place of the placeholder.

directories.description: Directory of each source. A null value means the directory is located by the same mechanism as the other layers of the team source.

project.description: Directory of the project source, relative to the project root.

user.description: Directory of the user source, relative to the home directory.

team.description: Directory of the team source, or null when it is located by the mechanism of the other layers.

merge.description: Merge behaviour between sources. Must be none: a profile replaces the whole source it comes from.

invalid_falls_back.description: Whether an invalid profile falls back to the next source. Must be false.

placeholders.description: Placeholders a path may start with. They are expanded before any path is compared.

default_network_port.description: Port assumed for a network destination that names none.

always_denied_executables.description: Harness executables a child may never invoke directly, whatever the profile says.

command_wrappers.description: Programs and shell reserved words that run the command given after them; the reference model looks through them.

command_interpreters.description: Shell interpreters whose inline script argument makes the syntax ambiguous.

implicit_denials.description: Denials every profile carries without listing them: the authority documents, the harness credentials and the main repository outside the run.

layers.description: Versions and vocabularies of the layers a delegation depends on.

version.description: Version of the permissions layer this contract reads. Must be 1.

envelopes.description: Permission envelopes the layer may name.

version.description: Version of the autonomy layer this contract reads. Must be 1.

profiles.description: Autonomy profiles the layer may name.

explicit_order_required_for.description: Autonomy profiles that delegate only on an explicit order from the operator.

rejection_reasons.description: Closed reasons a run can be rejected with, in snake_case.

required_enforcement.description: Authority rules an adapter must declare it can make effective before a run that uses a profile may start.
